user.title: Connect two Home Assistant instances
user.description: Install Beam on the local instance. Enter administrator tokens and confirm the entity prefix used on that instance.

source.title: Choose the first sync source
source.description: Choose which site supplies the first copy. After the first sync, changes can travel both ways.

new_destination.title: Set up the new destination
new_destination.description: Beam creates the destination during the first valid sync.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read both instances. Check the URLs and administrator tokens.
error.invalid_input: Enter two distinct Home Assistant URLs and a valid entity prefix.
error.invalid_dashboard_path: Enter a title and a lowercase dashboard path containing a hyphen, such as cabin-copy.
error.invalid_view_path: Enter a lowercase view path, such as home-4. A path containing only digits is reserved for positional views.
error.destination_exists: The destination path is already in use.
error.no_dashboards: Create an editable dashboard on at least one instance first.

abort.overlap: One of these dashboards or views is already managed by another rule.
